data.action: 手持苍蓝电弧双刃凌空跃起斩击，白狼尾狂甩，狂气大笑露出尖牙
data.camera: wide shot, low angle, explosive dynamic action
data.description: 【拉普兰德 · 狂月下的双刃猎杀】叙拉古废墟古罗马圆形剧场遗址上，血色满月高悬。拉普兰德手握双刃逆风跃起，银白色的凌乱长发在月光下如狂狼鬃毛般狂舞，双刃上缠绕着苍蓝色的源石电弧，狂气的笑容与尖牙展露无遗——「哈哈哈哈！来吧，让我见识一下你们的挣扎！千万不要太快死掉啊！」
data.lighting: 血色残月冷光与双刃苍蓝源石雷电强光
data.location: 叙拉古荒原古罗马斗兽场废墟
data.promptProse: Lappland leaps into the wind above a ruined Siracusan amphitheater, dual swords gripped firmly and sharp teeth exposed in a wild grin. Her ragged mercenary coat and silver hair lift with the motion. The low wide view shows fractured arena tiers behind her. A blood moon outlines the ruin; blue Originium arcs on the blades light her gloves and flashes of cloth beneath her airborne figure.
data.title: 拉普兰德 · 狂月下的双刃猎杀
